mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_COMMENT ( COMMENT_NO , COMMENT_CONTENT , REF_BNO , COMMENT_WRITER , CREATE_DATE , STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_CONO.NEXTVAL , #{commentContent} , #{refBno} , #{commentWriter} , SYSDATE , 'Y' )
